get.summary: Every account with its type, currency, state and today's balance; `archived=true` adds the archived ones.

post.summary: Creates a manual account, with its opening balance when given.

delete.summary: Deletes the account with its movements and balances, only when nothing rests on it (`conflict`, reason `in_use`).

get.summary: One account with its settings. Another person's account is `not_found`.

patch.summary: Changes an account's settings: a field left out keeps its value, `iban: null` removes the IBAN. A synced account keeps its currency.

post.summary: Archives an account: it keeps its history and leaves the lists. `restore` brings it back.

get.summary: The recorded balances of one account, newest first; `limit` 1-200, 200 when missing or not a number.

post.summary: Records the balance of a day, as the form does: a second reading of the same day replaces the first.

delete.summary: Deletes a balance a person recorded.

put.summary: Corrects a balance a person recorded; any other source is `conflict`.

get.summary: What an account's page shows around its figures: its provider, Investments, the pockets, subscriptions and interest rules on it, and the switch to the bank.
One account day by day from `from` to `to` (both included, at most 1100 days, cut at today): readings held, a synced account rebuilt from its movements.
What rests on the account and has to move before it can be deleted, and the open accounts it can move to.

post.summary: Moves one thing that rests on the account to another open account.

get.summary: The IBAN of an account, grouped by four as its page shows it; null when it has none. Only the web's own session reads it (H45): a token gets 403.
What hangs off an account: direct debits on its IBAN, charges on its card.

post.summary: Adds what hangs off an account; the same name twice on one channel is `conflict`.

delete.summary: Removes what hangs off an account.

put.summary: Changes what hangs off an account.

post.summary: Brings an archived account back.

delete.summary: «Undo switch»: the account goes back to its source of before.

post.summary: Applies the switch the report described: only with the report's `fingerprint` (`conflict`, reason `stale`).

get.summary: The step «Account» of the switch: the accounts of the person's banks in the account's currency that it can move to. No IBAN, whole or masked (H45): only whether it is the account's own.

post.summary: The dry run of moving the account to a bank's account: the report the person reads before «Apply».

get.summary: The bank's identifier of each account of `GET /accounts/{id}/switch/candidates`, masked: its first and last four characters. Only the web's own session reads it (H45): a token gets 403.
The account this one doubles (decision H58): every movement of it is one of the twin's. Open, what archiving it would record; archived, what was recorded. An archived double counts in no month.
The person's Client APIs (client credentials), newest first. Never a secret.

post.summary: Creates a Client API and answers its secret once: only its hash is kept.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the person's Client APIs; its tokens stop working at once.

get.summary: The banks of a country the bank plugin can connect.

post.summary: Starts the access to a bank: the answer is the bank's page.

get.summary: The budgets of one month with their limit, what was spent and the status, plus the totals and the spending no budget covers, as the Budgets page shows them.

schema.description: YYYY-MM; the current month when omitted.

get.summary: One budget's page: its row in `month`, the 6 months before it (newest first, the limit null in a month without one) and its alerts. `not_found` when the budget has no limit in `month`.

schema.description: YYYY-MM; the current month when omitted.

put.summary: When the budget emails: on or off, and the percentages of its limit that send one (sorted, without repeats, in the answer). Alerts on need a threshold.
Sets the budget's limit from `month` onwards: versions already set for later months are replaced. The amount is a positive decimal string.

post.summary: Takes the budget away from `month` onwards; the months before keep their limit. A budget stopped in the month it began leaves nothing behind.

get.summary: Overview's «Budgets» card: the budgets of the month closest to their limit, the highest `percent` first, 5 at most.

schema.description: YYYY-MM; the current month when omitted.

get.summary: The Budgets page of one month: the rows of `list_budgets` with what the page draws, the totals, the spending waiting for a category, the choices of «Add budget» and the first month with a limit.

schema.description: YYYY-MM; the current month when omitted.

get.summary: The person's categories in tree order, with how many movements each has.

post.summary: Creates a category or a group.

delete.summary: Deletes a category for good, and at the source it came from. `external` says what the source did.

patch.summary: Changes a category's name, group or colour.

post.summary: Archives a category, with the sub-categories of a group. `ids` is what «Undo» restores.

get.summary: What moving a group to another macro changes, before the move: movements, total, linked records.

post.summary: Moves a group, or a category of Transfers, to another macro. The numbers change; `undo` takes it back.
Moves a category to another group of the same macro. `fromId` is the group it left.

get.summary: What a category spent, received or moved in a period with its sub-categories: the amount and the movements, against the period before, by month, against its budget, its sub-categories and the source whose categories count under it.

Expenses › Categories in a period: Income, Expenses and Transfers with their totals, their groups (the movements on the group itself in `only`) and categories, the biggest first, and the movements without a category in `rest`.

post.summary: The default groups the person chose, in their language, then a pass of the cascade after the answer; answers how many were made.
Undoes a move to another macro with the `undo` the move answered.
Merges two categories: movements, sub-categories and budget limits of `dropId` go to `keepId`.

get.summary: Settings › Categories: the pairs of categories that look like the same one, each side with what the dialog says before the merge, and whether the merge sums two budgets.

post.summary: «They are different»: the pair is not proposed again.
«Undo» of «They are different».
Undoes a merge with the `undo` the merge answered.
Brings archived categories back: one, or every one an archive put away.

get.summary: The apps the person gave consent to, oldest first: the devices of the apps among them.

delete.summary: Takes a consent back: the app's refresh tokens go, and its next sign-in asks again.

get.summary: The person's connections with their state, schedule, capabilities and last runs: 10 runs each, or `runs` (at most 40).

post.summary: Connects a provider of the core that takes credentials, or replaces them. A refusal of the credentials is `invalid` with the card's code in `reason` (`empty`, `rejected`, `provider`).

delete.summary: Disconnects: the credentials go, the accounts and movements stay. Also cancels a bank connection not finished.

get.summary: The accounts the provider exposes now, and which of them the person chose.

put.summary: Chooses the accounts of a connection: a new account, an account here, or left out.

get.summary: The step «Accounts» of a bank's connection: the accounts the bank shares that are still to choose, the ones already here, and where each can go. `409 complete`: nothing is left to choose.

post.summary: «Turn on» the plugin of the connection; each of its connections is read at once.
Reads the history again, `months` back: one of `capabilities.historyMonths`.

get.summary: The step «Done» of a bank's connection: what the last reading did, account by account, how its movements stand with the categories, and the accounts to switch. `409 not_chosen`: the accounts are still to choose.

post.summary: Tries the first reading of a bank again, now, after a refusal.
Renews the access to a bank before or after it ends: the answer is the bank's page.
«Turn on again»: the provider's recommended schedule.

put.summary: Saves when the connection is read: times in the person's zone. No rule is «only by hand».

post.summary: The next passes of a schedule not saved yet, in the person's zone, and what is wrong with it. Saves nothing.
«Update now»: a reading in the worker's queue. The answer does not wait; the run is in `runs`.
Tries the saved credentials against the provider and records the verdict.

get.summary: The log of the readings of the last 30 days, newest first: of one connection with `connectionId`, of all of them without. Never what a provider said: a code of the closed list only.

The pension funds in a period: the portfolio's gain, market return, fees, paid-in money by origin and return; each fund's own measure; the bars of the gain, the value by day and, for «All», the years.

post.summary: Creates a fund with its account, sources and fees; `fees[].source` names a source of the same body by its place in `sources`. Answers the id and how many payslip periods it received.

get.summary: One fund's Overview in a period: its measure, its value today, its charts and its projection.

patch.summary: Renames a fund or changes its provider, compartment, start day or code.

post.summary: Reads again what every applied payslip accrued for the fund. Answers how many periods it published.

get.summary: A fund's Contributions tab: the register of the period, the periods of the payslip source with what they accrued and what the fund credited, and the months accrued and not received.
From one movement, the text a recurring debit would match on and the charges it already finds: how many, the first and the last, the median amount and the interval. `found` null: nothing to match on.

post.summary: Adds a fee: an amount or a percentage, on what it is charged, how often, and when it is in force.

delete.summary: Removes a fee.

get.summary: The movements a contribution or a recurring debit of the fund can be tied to: the last 60 that left the account asked for (any of the person's without one) since the fund started, newest first.

post.summary: Writes a contribution (voluntary, tied or not to the movement that paid it; or from the payslip, by component, for a period) or another operation (joining, transfer in, switch, exit). `fee` null: unknown.

delete.summary: Deletes an operation of the register.

patch.summary: Rewrites an operation written by hand.

delete.summary: Withdraws an accepted difference: the component is a discrepancy again.

put.summary: Accepts the difference between what the payslips accrued and what the fund credited for one component of one period, with a note. The difference is the server's; when it changes, the decision lapses.

get.summary: A fund's Settings tab: the fund, its sources and fees, and the payslip components other funds take.

post.summary: Adds a source of contributions: the payslip (components and period), a recurring bank debit, or by hand. One active payslip source per fund; a component goes to one fund only.

delete.summary: Removes a source with no contribution (one with contributions is paused instead: `conflict`). Answers the source and its own fees as they were, which `restore_fund_source` takes back.

patch.summary: Rewrites a source. A payslip source publishes the applied payslips again.

put.summary: Pauses a source or makes it active again.

post.summary: «Undo» of a removal: the source and its fees come back with the ids they had.

put.summary: Archives a fund or brings it back.

get.summary: A fund's Valuations tab: each reading of the period against the one before, and the values recorded.

post.summary: Records what the fund is worth on a day (not in the future). A day that has a value moves it.

delete.summary: Deletes a recorded value.

patch.summary: Changes a recorded value: a new day moves it, it never leaves a second one behind.

get.summary: What the form that creates a fund starts from: the fund templates, and the payslip components another fund already takes.

post.summary: Receives one document as `multipart/form-data` (`kind`, `file`) and starts its reading. The format is read from the content: a payslip is a PDF, of at most 10 MiB. The same file sent again is the same document (`duplicate: true`, 200). A fund's kinds are refused with 415 and nothing is kept. A `400` names the use case's refusal in `reason` (`empty`, `storage_failed`, …).

200.description: The file was already received: the same document.

get.summary: The interest rules (oldest first) with what each accrued since 1 January and its next payout, the totals of the year, and the open accounts a rule can be on, each saying whether it can publish.

post.summary: Creates a rule and accrues it at once up to yesterday, settling the periods that have closed. Rates are percentages; `conflict` (`not_synced`) for a rule that publishes on an account no source reads.

get.summary: One rule's page: the rule, where its account's balance stands for the accrual, its settlements (newest first) reconciled with what was paid, and its latest 90 days.

put.summary: Changes a rule: every field of the dialog, as `POST /interests` takes them. What is settled stays; the days after the last settled period are accrued again with the new terms.
«Mark as posted»: the person saw the record on the source; nothing is sent.

post.summary: «Post now» (from not posted) or, with `retry`, «Retry» (from unsure): publishes a settlement on the account's source once, and answers where its posting stands. A posting that could not land is an answer, not an error.

put.summary: Pauses or resumes a rule; resuming catches its days up.

get.summary: Every investment service with its value today, net invested, gain, simple return and XIRR, the portfolio's totals in the display currency, and `pnl`, the profit and loss of the period with its Modified Dietz return.

post.summary: Makes an investment or crypto account of Accounts a manual service: its value stays the account's balance, its deposits and withdrawals the account's movements. `not_eligible`: a fund's, another type, or already a service.

get.summary: A service's Overview in a period, with what its header and dialogs need: the service today, its P&L of the period with the Modified Dietz return, the chart, what each position added, the latest events.

patch.summary: Changes the web address of a service; an empty one removes it.

get.summary: A service's Activity in a period: fifty events a page, newest first, filtered by family, text or asset, with the counts, the months, the money in and out and the transfers to link; for a manual service, the bank movements of its account.

delete.summary: Disconnects the provider: the service becomes manual and keeps its history.

get.summary: A service's Connection (Settings for a manual one), today: what the provider gives, the readings, the corrections, the key's checks and the settings. The session's only (SEC-08); never a credential.
The open positions of one service today, in the service's currency.

post.summary: A dated decision on a manual position the provider's reading may cover: covered by the provider, partly (`quantity`), outside its scope (`product`), or reopened.

put.summary: Replaces the key of a connected service; the old one waits to be confirmed revoked.

post.summary: Checks the key at the provider and records the result. `not_read_only` when it is not provably read-only (it can write, or the provider cannot say).
Confirms that the retired keys were deleted at the provider.

Writes a valuation, a sale, a close or an income on a service (not in the future). A deposit, a withdrawal, an account valuation or a correction comes from Accounts or the provider: `409` `not_editable`. Answers the event's id.

delete.summary: Deletes an operation written by hand; its legs are kept as revisions.

get.summary: A synced service's Positions in a period: open on its last day with what each added, closed in it and ever, and the contributions that close on the Overview's P&L.

post.summary: Confirms that a reading of zero is real: the service was emptied.
«Sync now»: queues a pass of the service's connection and answers before the provider does. `cooldown` within a minute of the last pass.
Links a withdrawal and a deposit of two services as one transfer, as the proposals pair them: the portfolio leaves it out, each service keeps it as a flow. Answers the id of the pair.

delete.summary: Unlinks the transfer one of whose legs is the event: both are flows again.

put.summary: «Update value» of a manual service: the value read at the broker on a day, written as the manual balance of its account. `not_editable` on an account a provider reads.

get.summary: The providers a service can be added from, with the accounts each is connected to (`status` `planned`: one to come, which cannot be connected yet), and the investment and crypto accounts a service can use, with why one cannot.

post.summary: Connects a provider's read-only key to an investment or crypto account: checks the key, reads the first value and queues the history. `ipRestricted` null: the provider does not say.

get.summary: The home of a period: today's totals and allocation by class, service and currency, the pension funds, each service with its P&L of the period, contribution and alerts, the parts and the charts.
The person's labels, with how many movements carry each.

post.summary: Creates a label.

delete.summary: Deletes a label; the movements keep everything else.

patch.summary: Changes a label's name or colour.

get.summary: The version of the instance, the level of its API and what it can do.
The net worth and every account by month end, through `through` (this month when missing), for `months` months (1-120, 24 when missing).
The accounts «in the net worth» day by day from `from` to `to`, in the display currency at the rate of each day: at most the last 366 days of the window, cut at today.
The payees whose name contains the text, with how many movements each has (the ⌘K palette).
The code map: what each body code means, the profile's codes and the person's own.

delete.summary: Puts a code back to what the profile says, or removes a code the profile does not have.

put.summary: Sets what a code means; a code the map lacked is added.

get.summary: The register of payslips by year, with the year's totals and monthly means over the applied ones, the documents still being read or waiting, and the KPIs over the applied ordinary payslips.

delete.summary: Deletes a payslip with its original; an applied one leaves the register first. `unapplied`: it was applied; `restored`: the payslip it had replaced is applied again.

get.summary: One payslip's review: every value read and where from, the corrections, the checks and the warnings, the leave it accounts for, and its body lines with the role of each code.

patch.summary: Renames a payslip's document, whatever its state.

post.summary: Applies a verified payslip: it enters the register, the payslip with its key is superseded, its leave reaches time off and its contributions the pension fund that takes them.

put.summary: Confirms a value as read (`value` null) or corrects it, in canonical form: amounts and hours "1234.56", dates YYYY-MM-DD. A verified payslip that changes goes back to review. Answers the review.

post.summary: Asks the LLM fallback for the blank fields it may fill; what it fills is inferred and waits for a decision. `unavailable` (`reason` `llm_not_configured`, `llm_failed`) when it cannot answer. Only the web's own session calls it: a token gets 403.

get.summary: A signed address of the payslip's original PDF, valid for five minutes: it opens without a session or a token, so a viewer or another app can load it. A payslip whose original is gone is not found.

url.description: Where the original opens: `/api/v1/originals/<token>`, for anyone who holds it.

post.summary: Sets a payslip aside; nothing was applied from it.
Takes an applied payslip back to review; `restored`: the payslip it had replaced is applied again.
Reads the original again, keeping what a person decided on values that did not change.
A person vouches for the payslip: every inferred value decided first; failed checks only with `acknowledgeFailures`.

get.summary: Everyone who can reach the instance: the users, then the invitations still outstanding.

delete.summary: Deletes a person and everything they own. The last admin and the admin who asks are refused.

patch.summary: Changes a person's role or blocks them. The last admin and the admin who asks are refused.

post.summary: Emails a person a link to choose a new password.

delete.summary: Turns a person's two-factor sign-in off, for a lost device.

post.summary: Invites a person by email. `outcome` says whether the email left, or why it did not.

delete.summary: Withdraws an invitation: its link stops working.

get.summary: The plugins of the instance as the person has them: on, paused (since when) or available, with the state of the person's key. Never the key.

patch.summary: Turns a plugin on or off for the person.

delete.summary: Removes the credentials of a plugin's application.

put.summary: Checks and saves the credentials of a plugin's application. The key never comes back.

get.summary: The open pockets with what is left in each, the totals of the Pockets page (earmarked, the backing accounts' balance, what is free on them, the monthly accruals), the archived pockets and the accounts a pocket can rest on.

post.summary: Creates a pocket, on an open account or standalone. Target and monthly are positive decimal strings, or null.

get.summary: One open pocket's page: its row, what it was given, accrued and spent, the target's progress, the estimated interest, the month-end balance of the last 12 months, its expenses and the planned ones. `not_found` for an archived pocket.

put.summary: Changes a pocket: every field of the dialog, as `POST /pockets` takes them.

post.summary: Adds money to a pocket's budget on a day, today or before. The amount is a positive decimal string.

delete.summary: Takes an expense filed by hand out of a standalone pocket.

put.summary: Files an expense under a standalone pocket (`GET /pockets/candidates` lists the ones it can take).

post.summary: Plans an expense on a pocket for a day, today or later. The amount is a positive decimal string.

put.summary: Pauses, resumes, archives or restores a pocket.

get.summary: The expenses a standalone pocket can take: the visible expenses of the last 120 days, not on an account a pocket rests on and not filed under a pocket yet. Newest first.
Overview's «Pockets» tile: what the open pockets have left, what they are given each month, how many.

delete.summary: Removes a planned expense (the `id` of `planned[]` in `GET /pockets/{id}`).

get.summary: The person's preferences: language, zone, number format, display currency, theme, time off.

patch.summary: Changes some preferences; a field left out keeps its value. A new zone moves the sync times with it.

get.summary: Who the token acts for: name, email, role, and whether the identity provider manages them.

patch.summary: Changes the person's name. Refused with `conflict` (`reason: sso`) when the provider manages it.

get.summary: What the Profile form offers: the time zones with their offset now, and whether the instance sends the monthly summary.
The person's rules in their order, each with how many movements carry its category. With `category`, only the rules that give that category.

post.summary: A new rule; answers how many movements already here it would change. `conflict`, `reason` `limit`, when the person has as many rules as allowed.

delete.summary: Deletes a rule; «Undo» (`restore_rule`) for 7 days.

put.summary: Changes a rule; answers how many movements already here it would change.
Turns a rule on or off.

post.summary: «Apply» to the movements already here (§4.6): all or nothing, with «Undo».

get.summary: What «Apply to existing transactions» would change, and the rule's category.

post.summary: «Undo» of the deletion of a rule.
«Undo» of an «Apply».

get.summary: The editor filled from a movement (§4.7) or with a category chosen (§5.4); `draft: null` when neither gives one.

put.summary: The rules in their new order: the first that matches wins.

post.summary: The live preview of the editor: what the rule would change. `ruleId` leaves the rule being edited out. A rule not valid yet is `invalid`. Writes nothing.

get.summary: The person's pockets, funds and subscriptions whose name contains the text.
How the person signs in: password, identity provider (its origin only) and the instance's second-factor policy.

post.summary: Makes a backup of the database now and answers its size in bytes.

get.summary: Whether each plugin of the instance answers. A plugin that does not is `down` in its row; `503` only when the check cannot run.
Every job of the worker with its last run.

post.summary: Puts one job in the worker's queue. The answer does not wait: the run is in `GET /server/jobs`.

delete.summary: Removes the AI service and its key.

put.summary: Saves the AI service that reads a document when its reader cannot. An empty key keeps the saved one.

post.summary: Tries the saved key and model. Saves nothing; the service's answer is never quoted.

delete.summary: Removes the saved provider: the values of the environment apply again.

put.summary: Saves the sign-in provider. A new issuer signs everyone out (`signedEveryoneOut`).

post.summary: Reads the discovery document of the saved provider and records the verdict.

get.summary: The AI service, the sign-in provider, the mail transport and the maintenance facts. No secret.

delete.summary: Removes the saved transport: the values of the environment apply again.

put.summary: Saves the mail transport and which emails go out. An empty password keeps the saved one.

post.summary: Sends one email to the admin who asked, through the transport as it is saved.

get.summary: The person's open sign-ins on the web, newest first. Never a session token.

delete.summary: Signs one session out. A session that is not the person's answers as one already gone.

get.summary: The last 24 monthly snapshots, newest first (Settings › Data).

post.summary: «Take snapshot now»: the run the monthly job does, for the month of `on` (the previous month when missing). It replaces that month's snapshot.

get.summary: Every category the person's sources bring, and where its movements count here.

put.summary: Sets where a source's category counts: a category of the person, or its own (`null`).

post.summary: «Keep as it is» on a new category of a source: it stays added and is no longer new.
Undoes a change of where a source's category counts.

get.summary: The page of one source the person has: its accounts deleted here, what waits to be written to it, and what «Disconnect» of each connection leaves.

post.summary: Brings back an account deleted here: the source may bring it again. A bank's account is chosen again on `reconnect`.
Turns a source off after a last reading: its accounts are kept by hand from now.

get.summary: What turning a source off changes, before it is turned off.

The subscriptions (the active ones, then the paused and the cancelled), the totals of the Subscriptions page, the payment alerts, the yearly cost by category group, what the active ones commit on each paying account within 30 and 365 days, and the accounts a subscription can be paid from.

post.summary: Creates a subscription and checks its charges against the movements. The price is a positive decimal string, the tolerance a percentage (5 when left out).

delete.summary: Deletes a cancelled subscription and the charges it had checked; the movements stay. `conflict` (`not_cancelled`) for one that is not cancelled.

put.summary: Changes a subscription: every field of the dialog, as `POST /subscriptions` takes them; its charges are checked again.
Pauses, resumes, cancels or brings back a subscription.

get.summary: «Suggest from recurring payments»: the outgoing recurring payments with a subscription cycle that no subscription, in any state, covers yet. By name.
Net worth, liquid cash, and this month's income, spending and net (the Home Assistant card).
One year of time off: the residual of vacation and ROL with the formula that gave it, the year's totals by month and kind, the days and the payslips' months, the forecasts and the warnings.
The allowance stated for each year, newest first.

put.summary: States the allowance of a year, in days; null for a part nobody states.

delete.summary: Removes all the leave of one date. Answers what «Undo» sends back.

get.summary: The holiday calendars the person keeps, each with its days of this year and its last fetch.

post.summary: Keeps a calendar and fetches this year and the next. A fetch that fails keeps the calendar, with its error, and answers `unavailable`: the daily pass tries again.

delete.summary: Stops keeping a calendar; its days are no longer holidays.

post.summary: Fetches a calendar again, this year and the next, as the daily pass does.

get.summary: Every country either source can answer for, named in the person's language.
The places inside a country, when the source can name them; none otherwise.

delete.summary: Removes all the leave between two dates, ends included. Answers what «Undo» sends back.

post.summary: Books a range of days, one kind and one size for every day; weekends and holidays are left out. `editedKind` edits the row of one day; `otherKind` books «½ + ½». Answers what «Undo» sends back.

delete.summary: Removes one row of leave. Answers what «Undo» sends back.

post.summary: Puts the touched days back as they were before a write, in one transaction.

get.summary: Movements filtered like Expenses, with the totals of the whole filtered range (not just the page). Without `limit`, 500 rows.
One movement, as the pages draw it. Another person's movement is `not_found`.

patch.summary: The fields a person owns on a movement: its note (trimmed; empty is none) and its labels. Payee, amount and date belong to the source (`conflict`, reason `provider_owned`).

get.summary: The movements with the same text as this one that may take `categoryId` too (decision K3). Writes nothing.

patch.summary: Type, amount, payee and note of a movement its source lets change: written there first, then here. `conflict` with `reason` `not_linked` or `no_transfer_category`, or the source's own words when it refused; `unavailable` with its words when it could not be reached.

post.summary: The category chosen for a group or for similar movements: all of them or none. With «Undo».
«Confirm»: an automatic category or a suggestion becomes the person's own choice. With «Undo».
«Undo» of a confirmation or a choice.

put.summary: One category, or none, for a selection of movements; answers how many changed.

get.summary: How many movements each account, category and type holds in a filtered range.

post.summary: Writes a manual movement. `key` is the dialog's own: a second request with it answers with the row already written (`created: false`). `invalid` with `reason` `amount` or `future_date`; `conflict` with `reason` `account_unavailable`.

delete.summary: Deletes a manual movement and rebuilds its account's balance.

put.summary: Changes a manual movement; a movement of a source is `conflict`, `reason` `not_manual`.

post.summary: «Retry sending» a manual movement its source did not take: the source is updated now. `sent` says whether it went; why not is the connection's state.

get.summary: What the dialog of a manual movement offers: the accounts that take one, in the order of Accounts, with the source a «read and write» account sends it to, and today where the person is.

post.summary: Today's balance of the account before and after the movement being written, or the day of the reading that keeps it unchanged; null when there is nothing to say. Writes nothing.
The category the cascade would give the movement being written, from what is already known; null for none. Nothing is learnt or written.

get.summary: «To review» for a range: the accounts whose movements take an automatic category, the groups and the single movements waiting for one, the pairs of categories that look like the same one, and whether the first pass is still running. Without `accounts`, every account that takes one.
The movements of a filtered range summed by category (the card, with each one's share), by category and type, by day or by month.

The «By category» card on two levels, as the page draws it: one bar per group of categories, the biggest first, each with its sub-categories measured within it (what was filed on the group itself is one of them, under the group's name). Giroconti out; `total` is what the bars add up to.

The spending chart of a range: every day or month from `from` to `to` (today at the latest) with its total, and one series per group of categories with a value for every bucket, the biggest first. One `type` (spending when none), as `get_spending` by day or month.
What Expenses draws for a filter: a page of rows, the month headers and the totals of the whole range, the facets of the chips and the movements waiting for a category.

post.summary: Hides, restores or deletes for good (hidden rows only) a selection, and rebuilds the balance of each manual movement's account. `rebuildBalances` is accepted and has no effect: the balance is always rebuilt. A synced row deleted is never imported again.
